title: Batch Processing and Job Queue Test Cases: Companion Lab
title_es: Casos de Prueba de Procesamiento por Lotes y Colas: Lab Companion
description: In-memory stdlib job queue modeling the full lifecycle (queued, processing, retrying, dead_lettered, cancelled) with idempotency keys, retries, DLQ and replay. Pytest suite mirrors TC-001 through TC-037.
description_es: Cola de jobs en memoria solo stdlib que modela el ciclo de vida completo (queued, processing, retrying, dead_lettered, cancelled) con claves de idempotencia, reintentos, DLQ y replay. La suite pytest replica TC-001 a TC-037.
